features: 1st Ever Buds with an In-Case Display: Tune into a new perspective with our first-ever Noise View Buds featuring a 4.44 cm (1.75 inch) HD display right on the case and see your tunes come alive like never before
Active Noise Cancellation (up to 32 dB): Immerse yourself in pure sound. Tune out the chaos and dial into tranquillity with customisable ANC on both the earbuds and case
Find My Buds: Lost the Rhythm? Never miss a beat. The ‘Find my buds’ feature helps you locate them instantly
40 Hours of Playtime: Power through your playlists. With up to 40 hours of playtime, your music will outlast your day
10 mm Drivers: Turn up the volume on life. Enjoy powerful sound with larger 10 mm drivers that amplify every beat
In-Built EQ Modes: Customise your sound. Choose from three built-in EQ modes—Tru Balance, Tru Bass, and Tru Rock—for the perfect audio experience, no matter your mood
In-Built Storage: Music, anywhere, anytime. With up to 100 minutes of built-in storage, you can listen to your favourite tracks even without your phone
Quad Mic ENC: Stay connected with crystal-clear calls, thanks to Quad Mic Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC)
